Name: Slime Pets
Author: popando
Description:
[b][size=5]Overview[/size]
[/b]
 This mod makes your cat and dog into a blueish green colour to fit with all your pet slimes.

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

Just extract the .zip file and place the folder in your Stardew Valley Mods Folder. This mod requires SMAPI and Content Patcher to be installed.Because this mod used Content Patcher, you do not have to replace the XNB files inside the game.

[size=5][left][b][/b][/left][/size][size=5][b]Plans[/b][/size]

Feel free to post and suggest features I should add, heres the current list :

[*][s]Make a slime dog available [/s] [b][i]DONE[/i][/b]
[/list][size=5][b]Other Mods
[/b][/size]
I have another mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4316]Here[/url] that makes the horse and the livestock slimy also which pairs well with this mod.
